name: FlowCanvas
description: Node/flow editor canvas — templated nodes, SVG edges, pan, pointer-anchored wheel zoom, node drag with snapping, background grid and zoom controls.

api.name: FlowCanvas
api.description: Node/flow editor canvas — templated nodes, SVG edges, pan, pointer-anchored wheel zoom, node drag with snapping, background grid and zoom controls.

parameters.name: Nodes
parameters.description: The nodes to render. Two-way bindable (@bind-Nodes): every committed drag or keyboard move emits a new list through NodesChanged. Without a binding the canvas keeps its own copy until you pass a different list.

parameters.name: NodesChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new node list after a committed drag or keyboard move.

parameters.name: Edges
parameters.description: The edges to draw between nodes. Edges whose source or target node is missing are skipped. Two-way bindable (@@bind-Edges): a committed connect or delete emits a new list through EdgesChanged. Without a binding the canvas keeps its own copy until you pass a different list — the same echo/replace rule Nodes follows.

parameters.name: EdgesChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new edge list after a committed connect (when OnConnect has no handler) or a delete that removed edges.

parameters.name: Viewport
parameters.description: The pan/zoom state. Two-way bindable (@bind-Viewport). Setting a new value moves the canvas; the canvas reports user pans and zooms back through ViewportChanged. A zoom of 0 or less means "not set" (the canvas starts at 0,0 and 100%).

parameters.name: ViewportChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the viewport changes — at most once per animation frame while a pan or wheel zoom is running, once more when it ends, and after every imperative change (FitViewAsync, ZoomInAsync, ...).

parameters.name: NodeTemplate
parameters.description: Renders each node's content. The canvas wraps it in a positioned, focusable host. Without a template a node renders a small card with its Data (or Id).

parameters.name: EdgeLabelTemplate
parameters.description: Renders an edge's label. Without a template, Label (when set) renders as a small themed pill. Positioned at the path midpoint and moved live by the engine while a connected node is dragged.

parameters.name: NodeAriaLabel
parameters.description: Names a node for assistive technology (its host's aria-label and the "Connect from/to" handle labels). Without it every node is named by its Id.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Overlays rendered inside the pane: FlowBackground, FlowControls, FlowMiniMap, FlowPanel, your own panels.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: CSS height of the canvas.

parameters.name: MinZoom
parameters.description: Smallest zoom a gesture or method may reach.

parameters.name: MaxZoom
parameters.description: Largest zoom a gesture or method may reach.

parameters.name: FitViewOnInit
parameters.description: Fits every node into view once the canvas has mounted and measured its nodes (the nodes stay invisible until then, so the un-fitted frame never shows).

parameters.name: FitViewPadding
parameters.description: Breathing room for fit-view, as a fraction of the nodes' bounds (0.1 = 10%).

parameters.name: SnapToGrid
parameters.description: Snaps dragged and keyboard-moved nodes to SnapGrid. Two-way bindable (@bind-SnapToGrid) so FlowControls' ShowSnapToggle button can flip it; without a binding it still works, the canvas just keeps its own toggled copy after the first render (the same rule Nodes/Edges follow).

parameters.name: SnapToGridChanged
parameters.description: Raised when SnapToGrid changes — a caller toggle, or FlowControls' snap button.

parameters.name: SnapGrid
parameters.description: The snap grid in flow units (X, Y).

parameters.name: NodesDraggable
parameters.description: Nodes can be moved by dragging or with the arrow keys.

parameters.name: PanOnDrag
parameters.description: Dragging the empty background pans the canvas. Holding Space pans from anywhere either way.

parameters.name: ZoomOnScroll
parameters.description: The mouse wheel zooms, anchored on the pointer (a plain wheel — no modifier — like React Flow; the page does not scroll while the pointer is over the canvas).

parameters.name: NodesConnectable
parameters.description: Dragging from a source FlowHandle to a target handle proposes a connection (pointer or keyboard — Enter on a source handle, then Enter on a target). ANDed with Connectable on both ends, Readonly and the controls' lock toggle.

parameters.name: ElementsSelectable
parameters.description: Nodes and edges can be selected: click, shift/ctrl-click to toggle, shift-drag for a marquee (SelectionOnShiftDrag). ANDed with Selectable per node.

parameters.name: SelectionOnShiftDrag
parameters.description: Shift-dragging the empty background draws a marquee that selects every intersected, selectable node. Requires ElementsSelectable.

parameters.name: DeleteKey
parameters.description: Key names (KeyboardEventArgs.Key) that delete the current selection while focus is anywhere inside the canvas.

parameters.name: Readonly
parameters.description: Turns every editing gesture off (node drag, keyboard move, connect and delete). Pan, zoom, selection and click events keep working.

parameters.name: History
parameters.description: When set, the canvas records a snapshot after every committed change (drag stop, keyboard move, connect, delete, an externally-applied Nodes/Edges replace such as an auto-layout result) and handles Ctrl+Z (undo), Ctrl+Shift+Z and Ctrl+Y (redo) while the canvas has focus. Selection changes alone do not push a snapshot. Share one FlowHistory with your own undo/redo UI if you have one — UndoAsync/RedoAsync are also public for that.

parameters.name: EdgesReconnectable
parameters.description: Lets an existing selected edge's end be re-dragged onto a different handle (a small grab handle at each end of a selected edge). See OnReconnect.

parameters.name: ConnectionMode
parameters.description: What a connect gesture accepts. Strict (default) only lets a drag start on a Source handle and land on a Target handle, like every earlier phase. Loose lets a drag start on ANY handle and land on any OTHER handle (source-to-source, target-to-target included) — the drag's start becomes Source, its end Target, regardless of either handle's declared FlowHandleType. IsValidConnection still runs on top of either mode.

parameters.name: HelperLines
parameters.description: While a single node is dragged (and SnapToGrid is off), snaps it to the nearest other node's left/centre/right and top/middle/bottom within HelperLineThreshold and draws the matching guide(s) in the edge SVG layer. Off by default. A multi-node drag (several selected nodes moved together) does not compute helper lines.

parameters.name: HelperLineThreshold
parameters.description: How close (in flow units) a dragged node's edge must be to another node's for a helper line to appear.

parameters.name: NewNodeId
parameters.description: Names newly created nodes for Ctrl+V (paste) and Ctrl+D (duplicate). Defaults to a short GUID-derived id ("flow-node-" + Guid.NewGuid()). Called once per copied node.

parameters.name: ValidateOnHover
parameters.description: A hovered connection target is validated against IsValidConnection DURING the drag (one interop round trip per hovered handle change) instead of only on drop, and marked data-flow-handle-invalid when it would be rejected. Off by default — the structural heuristic (data-flow-handle-valid) is free; this costs a round trip per hover.

parameters.name: EdgeLabelEditable
parameters.description: Double-clicking an edge's label opens an inline text box (Enter commits, Escape cancels). Off by default.

parameters.name: OnlyRenderVisibleNodes
parameters.description: Virtualization for large graphs: only nodes whose rect intersects the visible viewport plus one viewport of margin in every direction are mounted (plus their parent groups, and any node being dragged), and only edges touching a mounted node are drawn. The window follows pans and zooms with hysteresis — it is rebuilt only once the viewport has drifted half a viewport away (or zoomed in past half its size) — at most every 80 ms while a gesture runs, plus once when it ends. Selection, delete, clipboard, keyboard moves, FitViewAsync, FlowMiniMap and export keep working on EVERY node (they read the model, not the DOM); sizes measured while a node was mounted are remembered after it unmounts. Helper lines, marquee and connect targets only see mounted nodes (everything within one viewport of the visible area). Off by default.

parameters.name: OnNodeClick
parameters.description: A node was clicked (not raised for the click that ends a drag).

parameters.name: OnNodeDoubleClick
parameters.description: A node was double-clicked.

parameters.name: OnNodeContextMenu
parameters.description: A node was right-clicked. The browser menu is suppressed while this has a handler.

parameters.name: OnPaneClick
parameters.description: The empty background was clicked (not dragged); the point is in flow coordinates.

parameters.name: OnNodeDragStop
parameters.description: A drag (or arrow-key move) was committed; one entry per moved node. Raised after NodesChanged.

parameters.name: OnEdgeClick
parameters.description: An edge was clicked (not raised for the click that ends a drag or that opens a connection).

parameters.name: OnConnect
parameters.description: A connection was dropped on a compatible target handle and passed IsValidConnection. Without a handler the canvas appends a new FlowEdge itself and raises EdgesChanged.

parameters.name: IsValidConnection
parameters.description: Called for every proposed connection (pointer drop or keyboard commit) before it is accepted. Returning false rejects it — no edge is added and OnConnect is not raised.

parameters.name: OnReconnect
parameters.description: An existing selected edge's end was dragged onto a different (or the same) compatible handle and passed IsValidConnection. Without a handler the canvas replaces the edge's moved end itself and raises EdgesChanged. Requires EdgesReconnectable.

parameters.name: OnSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the selection changes — a click, shift/ctrl-click, marquee, edge click, SelectAsync, ClearSelectionAsync or a pane click/Escape that clears it.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: DeleteKey was pressed with a non-empty, deletable selection. Without a handler the canvas removes the selected nodes (and every edge touching one of them) and the directly selected edges itself, raising NodesChanged/EdgesChanged.

parameters.name: OnNodeResizeStop
parameters.description: A node was resized by a FlowNodeResizer grip or Shift+arrow keys; one entry per resized node. Raised after NodesChanged.

parameters.name: OnPaste
parameters.description: Ctrl+V pasted (or Ctrl+D duplicated) a selection. Raised after NodesChanged/EdgesChanged, with the NEW nodes/edges selected.

parameters.name: OnEdgeLabelChanged
parameters.description: An edge's inline-edited label was committed (EdgeLabelEditable, Enter). Unlike OnConnect/OnDelete/OnReconnect this is a plain notification, not a veto point — there is nothing to validate — so the canvas ALWAYS updates Label itself and raises EdgesChanged first, then this.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes merged onto the root element.

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the root element.

events.name: NodesChanged
events.description: Raised with the new node list after a committed drag or keyboard move.

events.name: EdgesChanged
events.description: Raised with the new edge list after a committed connect (when OnConnect has no handler) or a delete that removed edges.

events.name: ViewportChanged
events.description: Raised when the viewport changes — at most once per animation frame while a pan or wheel zoom is running, once more when it ends, and after every imperative change (FitViewAsync, ZoomInAsync, ...).

events.name: SnapToGridChanged
events.description: Raised when SnapToGrid changes — a caller toggle, or FlowControls' snap button.

enums.name: FlowConnectionMode
enums.description: What a connection gesture (pointer drag or keyboard connect) accepts as a valid target (phase 4). Structural only — IsValidConnection still runs on top of either mode.

enums.name: FlowHandleType
enums.description: Whether a FlowHandle starts connections (Source) or accepts them (Target).

enums.name: FlowPosition
enums.description: The PHYSICAL side of a node a handle sits on, and the direction an edge leaves/enters it. Physical, not logical: Left stays left under dir="rtl" (the canvas is a geometric surface, not a text flow).

records.name: FlowCanvasContext
records.signature: FlowCanvasContext(FlowCanvas Canvas, FlowViewport Viewport, FlowViewport InitialViewport, bool Locked, double MinZoom, double MaxZoom, bool SnapToGrid, int HistoryVersion)
records.description: What the canvas cascades to FlowBackground, FlowControls and its own node/edge layers. Re-created on every render (cascaded with IsFixed="false").

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: What the grid draws.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Dot radius (dots) or half the arm length (cross), in flow units. Ignored for lines.

parameters.name: ShowSnapToggle

parameters.name: ShowHistory

# FlowCanvas

Node/flow editor canvas — templated nodes, SVG edges, pan, pointer-anchored wheel zoom, node drag with snapping, background grid and zoom controls.

**Package:** `Lumeo.Flow` · **Category:** Data Display
**Docs:** https://lumeo.nativ.sh/components/flow-canvas

## Slots
- `NodeTemplate` (FlowCanvas) — Renders each node's content. The canvas wraps it in a positioned, focusable host. Without a template a node renders a small card with its Data (or Id).
- `EdgeLabelTemplate` (FlowCanvas) — Renders an edge's label. Without a template, Label (when set) renders as a small themed pill. Positioned at the path midpoint and moved live by the engine while a connected node is dragged.
- `ChildContent` (FlowCanvas) — Overlays rendered inside the pane: FlowBackground, FlowControls, FlowMiniMap, FlowPanel, your own panels.
- `ChildContent` (FlowControls) — Extra buttons appended after the built-in ones.
- `ChildContent` (FlowGroupNode) — Extra content rendered below the label (a toolbar, a badge).
- `ChildContent` (FlowNodeToolbar) — The toolbar's content — usually a row of Buttons.
- `ChildContent` (FlowPanel) — The panel's content.

## Events
- `NodesChanged` (`EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNode>>`) — Raised with the new node list after a committed drag or keyboard move.
- `EdgesChanged` (`EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowEdge>>`) — Raised with the new edge list after a committed connect (when OnConnect has no handler) or a delete that removed edges.
- `ViewportChanged` (`EventCallback<FlowViewport>`) — Raised when the viewport changes — at most once per animation frame while a pan or wheel zoom is running, once more when it ends, and after every imperative change (FitViewAsync, ZoomInAsync, ...).
- `SnapToGridChanged` (`EventCallback<bool>`) — Raised when SnapToGrid changes — a caller toggle, or FlowControls' snap button.
- `OnNodeClick` (`EventCallback<FlowNode>`) — A node was clicked (not raised for the click that ends a drag).
- `OnNodeDoubleClick` (`EventCallback<FlowNode>`) — A node was double-clicked.
- `OnNodeContextMenu` (`EventCallback<FlowNodeContextMenuEventArgs>`) — A node was right-clicked. The browser menu is suppressed while this has a handler.
- `OnPaneClick` (`EventCallback<FlowPoint>`) — The empty background was clicked (not dragged); the point is in flow coordinates.
- `OnNodeDragStop` (`EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNodeChange>>`) — A drag (or arrow-key move) was committed; one entry per moved node. Raised after NodesChanged.
- `OnEdgeClick` (`EventCallback<FlowEdge>`) — An edge was clicked (not raised for the click that ends a drag or that opens a connection).
- `OnConnect` (`EventCallback<FlowConnection>`) — A connection was dropped on a compatible target handle and passed IsValidConnection. Without a handler the canvas appends a new FlowEdge itself and raises EdgesChanged.
- `OnReconnect` (`EventCallback<FlowReconnectEventArgs>`) — An existing selected edge's end was dragged onto a different (or the same) compatible handle and passed IsValidConnection. Without a handler the canvas replaces the edge's moved end itself and raises EdgesChanged. Requires EdgesReconnectable.
- `OnSelectionChanged` (`EventCallback<FlowSelection>`) — Raised after the selection changes — a click, shift/ctrl-click, marquee, edge click, SelectAsync, ClearSelectionAsync or a pane click/Escape that clears it.
- `OnDelete` (`EventCallback<FlowSelection>`) — DeleteKey was pressed with a non-empty, deletable selection. Without a handler the canvas removes the selected nodes (and every edge touching one of them) and the directly selected edges itself, raising NodesChanged/EdgesChanged.
- `OnNodeResizeStop` (`EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNodeResizeChange>>`) — A node was resized by a FlowNodeResizer grip or Shift+arrow keys; one entry per resized node. Raised after NodesChanged.
- `OnPaste` (`EventCallback<FlowPasteEventArgs>`) — Ctrl+V pasted (or Ctrl+D duplicated) a selection. Raised after NodesChanged/EdgesChanged, with the NEW nodes/edges selected.
- `OnEdgeLabelChanged` (`EventCallback<FlowEdge>`) — An edge's inline-edited label was committed (EdgeLabelEditable, Enter). Unlike OnConnect/OnDelete/OnReconnect this is a plain notification, not a veto point — there is nothing to validate — so the canvas ALWAYS updates Label itself and raises EdgesChanged first, then this.
